order.list.searchHint: An exact order number (for example 7K3M-9QX2; lower case and a missing dash are fine) or the exact email the order was placed with; at most {max} characters. No partial matches.
order.list.searchTooLong: The search is too long for an order number or an email.
order.list.timeZoneHint: Days are read in this browser's time zone, from the start of the first day to the end of the last day.
order.list.rangeNotSent: The list is not loaded until the dates are corrected.
order.list.dateRange.invalid_day: This is not a valid day.
order.list.dateRange.end_before_start: The last day is before the first day.
order.list.caption: Orders, newest first
order.list.pastEnd: This page is past the end of the list.
order.list.emptyBody: Orders placed in the shop appear here.
order.list.noMatchBody: The search finds an exact order number or an exact email only. Check it, or clear the filters.
order.list.openById: Open the order with this id
order.refusal.amount_mismatch: The API refused the amount: it is not the order total in the order's currency. Nothing was recorded. The order was read again; check its total and try again.
order.refusal.awaiting_stock: A backordered line is not in stock yet, so the order cannot be fulfilled. Nothing was changed. Receive the stock on the product's Stock tab, then try again.
order.refusal.order_not_payable: This order can no longer be marked paid: it is cancelled or expired, or one of its reservations is no longer held. Nothing was recorded. The order was read again.
order.refusal.payment_reference_conflict: The order is already paid with another payment reference. Nothing was changed; the history shows the payment.
order.refusal.payment_in_progress: An online payment of this order is in progress. Nothing was changed; wait until the payment provider confirms or declines it.
order.refusal.invalid_transition: The order's status does not allow this any more (someone may have changed it). Nothing was changed; the order was read again.
order.field.invalid_characters: This text contains control characters. Type it again without them.
order.field.confirmation_required: Confirm that you received this amount.
order.actor.removedAdmin: An admin whose account was deleted
order.detail.title: Order {number}
order.detail.actionsHint: The server checks every action again; if the order changed meanwhile, its answer is shown here.
order.detail.accountDeleted: Placed with an account that was deleted since
order.detail.name: Name
order.lines.caption: Lines of order {number}
order.history.caption: Status history of order {number}
order.notice.done.markPaid: The order is marked paid. The history below shows the change.
order.notice.done.markFulfilled: The order is marked fulfilled. The history below shows the change.
order.notice.done.cancel: The order is cancelled. The history below shows the change.
order.notice.unknown.markFulfilled: No answer arrived, so the order may or may not be fulfilled. It was read again: check its status and history before trying again.
order.notice.unknown.cancel: No answer arrived, so the order may or may not be cancelled. It was read again: check its status and history before trying again.
order.notice.unknownPaid.recorded: No answer arrived, but the order was read again: the payment with reference {reference} is recorded and the order is paid.
order.notice.unknownPaid.not_recorded: No answer arrived. The order was read again and is still awaiting payment: the payment with reference {reference} was not recorded. You may mark it paid again; the dialog keeps the same reference, and the API records one payment per reference (the same reference on an order that is already paid changes nothing).
order.notice.unknownPaid.paid_with_other: No answer arrived. The order was read again: it is paid, but with another reference than {reference}. Check the history before doing anything else.
order.notice.unknownPaid.not_payable: No answer arrived. The order was read again: it is cancelled or expired, and the payment with reference {reference} was not recorded.
order.notice.unknownPaid.unreadable: No answer arrived, and the order could not be read again either. Reload the page before trying again; marking it paid again with the same reference {reference} cannot record a second payment.
order.markPaid.title: Mark order {number} paid
order.markPaid.description: Record a payment received outside the shop (for example a bank transfer). The payment is sent once; nothing is retried by itself.
order.markPaid.amountHint: The order total. It cannot be changed: the shop takes only full payments of the total.
order.markPaid.retryHint: The last attempt got no answer. Its reference is filled in: sending the same reference again cannot record a second payment.
order.markPaid.referenceHint: The bank transfer number or receipt, at most {max} characters. It identifies this payment.
order.fulfil.title: Mark order {number} fulfilled
order.fulfil.description: The stock still held for backordered lines is taken out. If such a line is not in stock yet, the order stays paid and nothing changes.
order.cancel.title: Cancel order {number}
order.cancel.paidBody: Cancelling does not restock and does not refund anything: the sold units stay sold. Record the stock return on the product's Stock tab and make the refund by hand. Only units still reserved for a backordered line are released.
order.cancel.unpaidBody: The order's reserved stock is released, so the units can be sold again.
order.cancel.reasonHint: Kept on the order and in its history; at most {max} characters.
shipment.title: Delivery and shipments
shipment.snapshot.none: The order was placed without a delivery method.
shipment.snapshot.payer.shop_charge: The shopper paid the shop's price
shipment.snapshot.payer.recipient_on_del: The recipient pays the carrier on delivery
shipment.list.none: No waybill has been created for this order.
shipment.card.title: Waybill {tracking}
shipment.card.unknownBody: The carrier's answer was lost, so a waybill may exist at the carrier. Do not create another one: ask the carrier what it has with “Check with the carrier”.
shipment.card.pendingBody: The carrier has not answered yet. Read the page again in a moment. If it stays so for more than two minutes, “Check with the carrier” appears.
shipment.card.pendingStaleBody: The waybill was left half created (for example by a server restart). Ask the carrier what it has with “Check with the carrier”.
shipment.card.failedBody: The carrier did not create this waybill. A new waybill can be created.
shipment.action.label: Print label
shipment.journal.caption: Status journal of a waybill of order {number}
shipment.create.title: Create a waybill
shipment.create.intro: Creates a waybill at the carrier ({carrier}). The recipient and the address come from the order. Creating a waybill changes neither the order nor its stock: marking the order fulfilled stays a manual step.
shipment.create.noCarrier: This order has no carrier delivery, so no waybill can be created.
shipment.create.exists: A waybill already exists for this order (status: {status}). Only one waybill can be active; cancel it, or wait until it ends, to create another.
shipment.create.notPaidYet: The order is not paid yet. Mark it paid first: only a paid order can be shipped.
shipment.create.notShippable: Only a paid order can be shipped. This order is: {status}.
shipment.create.declaredHint: Starts as the order subtotal. Type it with a dot, at most {decimals} digits after it.
shipment.create.payerHint: Preselected from the delivery method the shopper chose.
shipment.create.descriptionHint: Sent to the carrier only and not stored. Up to {max} characters.
shipment.error.wholeNumber: Enter a whole number, digits only.
shipment.error.checkFields: Some values are not valid. Check the marked fields. Nothing was sent.
shipment.money.comma_separator: Use a dot, not a comma, as the decimal separator.
shipment.money.inner_space: Remove the spaces inside the number.
shipment.money.invalid_format: Enter a number such as 80 or 80.50.
shipment.money.too_many_decimals: At most {decimals} digits after the dot.
shipment.money.negative_amount: The amount must not be negative.
shipment.cancel.title: Cancel the waybill {tracking}?
shipment.cancel.body: The carrier voids the waybill. The order and its stock are not changed: marking the order fulfilled stays a manual step.
shipment.notice.failedTitle: The carrier did not create the waybill
shipment.notice.failed.rejected: The carrier refused the waybill. Check the parcel, the declared value and the carrier's profile in the Shipping settings, then create it again.
shipment.notice.failed.invalid_credentia: The carrier does not accept the server's credentials. Ask your developers to check the carrier's API key (an environment variable of the server). Nothing was created.
shipment.notice.failed.not_supported: This carrier cannot create waybills. Nothing was created.
shipment.notice.failed.unavailable: The carrier could not be reached. Nothing was created; you can try again.
shipment.notice.unknownCreate: The carrier did not answer in time, so a waybill may exist at the carrier. Do not create another one: use “Check with the carrier” on the waybill below.
shipment.notice.lostCreate: No answer arrived from the server, so a waybill may or may not have been started. The order was read again. If a waybill with the status “Pending” or “Result unknown” appears, use “Check with the carrier”; do not create another.
shipment.notice.reconciledFound: The carrier has this waybill: it is created now.
shipment.notice.reconciledNone: The carrier has no such waybill: it is marked failed, and a new waybill can be created.
shipment.notice.refreshed: Tracking was refreshed. The journal shows any change.
shipment.notice.cancelled: The waybill was cancelled at the carrier.
shipment.notice.labelReady: The label PDF was handed to your browser as a download.
shipment.notice.lost.refresh: No answer arrived, so the tracking may or may not have been refreshed. The order was read again: check the journal.
shipment.notice.lost.reconcile: No answer arrived, so the check may or may not have settled the waybill. The order was read again: check its status before trying again.
shipment.notice.lost.cancel: No answer arrived, so the waybill may or may not be cancelled. The order was read again: check its status and journal before trying again.
shipment.notice.lost.label: No answer arrived, so the label was not downloaded. You can try again.
shipment.unavailable: The carrier could not be reached. Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
shipment.unavailableRetry: The carrier could not be reached. Nothing was changed. Try again in about {seconds} seconds.
shipment.refusal.order_not_paid: Only a paid order can be shipped. Mark the order paid first. The order was read again.
shipment.refusal.awaiting_stock: A backordered line is not in stock yet, so the order cannot be shipped. Receive the stock on the product's Stock tab, then try again.
shipment.refusal.no_carrier: This order has no carrier delivery (no delivery method, or one without a carrier), so no waybill can be created.
shipment.refusal.provider_not_enabled: The carrier of this order is not enabled in this shop any more. Ask your developers to enable it (the server setting SHIPPING_PROVIDERS_ENABLED).
shipment.refusal.carrier_not_supported: This carrier does not support this action. Nothing was changed.
shipment.refusal.shipment_exists: This order already has an active waybill (a waybill with an unknown result counts). The order was read again: use “Check with the carrier” or cancel it, do not create another.
shipment.refusal.shipment_not_unknown: This waybill is not waiting for a check any more (someone may have settled it). Nothing was sent to the carrier. The order was read again.
shipment.refusal.reconcile_too_early: The carrier does not list this waybill yet, which is normal in the first minutes after a lost answer. Nothing was changed and the waybill stays “result unknown”: check with the carrier again in a few minutes. Do not create another waybill.
shipment.refusal.shipment_not_tracked: This waybill cannot be tracked: it has no number yet, or it is over. The order was read again.
shipment.refusal.invalid_transition: The waybill's status does not allow this any more (someone may have changed it). Nothing was sent to the carrier. The order was read again.
shipment.refusal.label_not_available: There is no label for this waybill (it has no number at the carrier, or it was cancelled).
shipment.refusal.carrier_rejected: The carrier refused the request. Nothing was changed.
shipment.refusal.carrier_invalid_credent: The carrier does not accept the server's credentials. Nothing was changed. Ask your developers to check the carrier's API key (an environment variable of the server).
order.detail.contactErased: The contact data of this order (names, email, phone and the addresses except the country) was erased on {date}, at the request of the person or when the retention period ended. The order, its lines, totals, payments and shipments are kept.
shipment.refusal.contact_erased: The contact data of this order was erased, so a waybill can no longer be created or refreshed for it. Nothing was sent to the carrier.
